description.value: Waves Coffee House is a BC-born specialty coffee chain founded in Vancouver in 2005, serving espresso drinks made with 100% Specialty Grade Arabica beans and real Belgian chocolate. This Pitt Meadows location offers a bookable private meeting room seating up to 7 people, equipped with a 65" Smart TV, power outlets, and complimentary Wi-Fi. A full fresh food menu including sandwiches, wraps, and soups makes it a convenient stop for cyclists looking for a sit-down break along Harris Road.

address.value: 12099 Harris Road #106, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 0E5

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 35m; rack (6 spaces) at 58m; rack (5 spaces, covered) at 61m; rack (5 spaces) at 95m. Total: 21 spaces.

Wi-Fi is confirmed both by OSM (internet_access=wlan, fee=customers) and the website amenities list ('WIFI'). Takeout is confirmed by OSM takeaway=yes and website 'Order Pickup' / DoorDash options. Bike parking, water refill, and washrooms are not mentioned anywhere in OSM tags or website content, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible coffee shop with confirmed website and operating hours. Useful rest stop for touring cyclists along Harris Road in Pitt Meadows.
enrichment_extras.notes: Parking is listed as an amenity on the website, suggesting a vehicle parking lot is available, which may also accommodate bikes informally. Meeting room with power outlets requires booking and a minimum of 3 guests, so it is not counted as general device charging.
